description: This file defines the TenantDataSourceFactory class responsible for creating configured HikariDataSource instances for tenants in a multi-tenant application. It includes dependency injection, logging, and connection setup code specific to tenant database connections.

classes.name: TenantDataSourceFactory
classes.description: Service class responsible for creating and configuring DataSource instances for tenants based on their specific connection information.

methods.name: TenantDataSourceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies: the base tenant DataSource and the password encryptor.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new HikariDataSource for the specified tenant, setting connection properties and validating credentials.
